name: post-reboot-item251-replay

base_results.finding: clean item251 reference with exact binary dd022982 and default 12-endpoint topology
same binary/config no longer reproduced item251 after host/runtime drift
post-run snapshot identified validator-4 as the strongest host/runtime outlier under the same binary/config

hypothesis: The item251 replay drift is caused by transient VPS/runtime host state rather than code or Ansible config. Rebooting all four hosts, redeploying the exact item251 binary/config, wiping chain state, and rerunning the default 100k/60s benchmark should recover item251-class throughput if the issue is host-runtime drift.

git_environment_anchors.expected_ansible_config: default three-ingress topology from kombat_live_testnet group vars

planned_commands: cd chain/deploy/ansible && KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=$(grep -m1 '^KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=' /tmp/and-live-testnet/validator-1.env | cut -d= -f2-) .venv/bin/ansible kombat_live_testnet -m reboot -a 'reboot_timeout=600'

cd chain/deploy/ansible && KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=$(grep -m1 '^KOMBAT_OPERATOR_TOKEN=' /tmp/and-live-testnet/validator-1.env | cut -d= -f2-) .venv/bin/ansible kombat_live_testnet -m shell -a 'set -euo pipefail; systemctl stop kombat-chain-ingress3 kombat-chain-ingress2 kombat-chain-ingress kombat-chain; rm -rf /var/lib/and-chain; mkdir -p /var/lib/and-chain/snapshots; chown -R and-chain:and-chain /var/lib/and-chain; systemctl start kombat-chain; systemctl start kombat-chain-ingress kombat-chain-ingress2 kombat-chain-ingress3'
execution_notes: All four hosts rebooted successfully through Ansible: validator-1 elapsed 80s, validator-2 37s, validator-3 38s, validator-4 52s.
validator-1 nginx was active after reboot and was stopped again before deploy; validators 2-4 reported nginx absent.
The first ad-hoc wipe command failed before doing work because Ansible used /bin/sh and rejected pipefail. The command was rerun successfully with executable=/bin/bash.
All four validators verified the exact replay binary sha256 dd02298286ef973ebc1eec24459cd58cdc80f7c5c5e97ffee48d52b5979881dd before the benchmark.

decision.reason: Rebooting the hosts improved throughput from item256's 25,380.6 TPS to 35,953.1 TPS and preserved correctness, but it did not recover item251-class green throughput. Validator-4 remains the weakest ingress host and v1 remains weak; v2/v3 are still the only endpoints near target. The issue is not transient enough to solve with a simple reboot.
decision.next_move: Run a host/role isolation experiment: either swap validator roles across physical hosts or provision a fresh Ansible baseline, then replay the exact item251 binary/config. Avoid protocol code changes until host topology is controlled again.

rollback: The exact item251 binary/config remains deployed. Do not treat this as a code regression fix; use the result to drive host role-swap or fresh-node recovery.
